glossary.met: MET — Mission elapsed time, counted from the demo epoch (10 Nov 2026, Taipei).
glossary.spe: SPE — Solar proton event. High-energy protons from the Sun. The demo overlay is labeled and is not live NOAA flux.
glossary.kp: Kp — Planetary geomagnetic index (0–9) from NOAA SWPC.
glossary.gScale: G-scale — NOAA geomagnetic storm scale G0–G5, derived from Kp.
glossary.sScale: S-scale — NOAA solar radiation storm scale S0–S5, from ≥10 MeV protons.
glossary.rScale: R-scale — NOAA radio blackout scale R0–R5, from GOES X-ray class.
glossary.ared: ARED — Advanced Resistive Exercise Device (weight-stack analog).
glossary.cevis: CEVIS — Cycle Ergometer with Vibration Isolation (station bike).
glossary.t2: T2 — COLBERT treadmill for aerobic countermeasure.
glossary.eclss: ECLSS — Environmental Control and Life Support System (cabin air, water, thermal).
glossary.donki: DONKI — NASA Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information (GST, CME, SEP, notifications). Flare class is from NOAA GOES, not DONKI FLR.
glossary.msv: mSv — millisievert, a dose unit. Crew values here are simulated.
glossary.hrv: HRV — Heart-rate variability (ms). Lower can mean stress or fatigue.
glossary.sans: SANS — Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome, a NASA HRP ocular risk category. Values here are a fluid-shift analog, not flight OCT.
glossary.pvt: PVT — Psychomotor vigilance test reaction time (ms). Simulated performance analog.
glossary.ppco2: ppCO₂ — Partial pressure of carbon dioxide in the cabin (mmHg). ECLSS demo reading.
glossary.ppo2: ppO₂ — Partial pressure of oxygen (mmHg). ECLSS demo reading.
glossary.bmd: BMD — Bone mineral density. Estimated unloading loss is a labeled simulation, not DXA.
glossary.bhp: BHP — NASA HRP Behavioral Health and Performance risk category (generic grouping).
glossary.orthostatic: Orthostatic flag — simulated stand-test analog (heart-rate jump after unloading).
glossary.logmar: logMAR — logarithm of the minimum angle of resolution; visual-acuity change analog.
glossary.careerDose: Career dose analog — demo comparison to a 600 mSv NASA STD-3001-style limit. Not a real crew dose.
glossary.eihso: EIHSO-202 — HRP Earth-Independent Human Systems Operations item: recommendations for a semi-autonomous monitoring dashboard (RAP June 2026).
glossary.sol: Sol — a Mars day, 24 h 39 m 35 s. NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 lighting rationale notes a ~24 h 40 min cycle.

sources.hint: Official feeds only use verified public URLs. Physiology bands are demo policy — no invented papers.

noaa.used: G/R/S scale mapping (Kp, GOES X-ray peak, ≥10 MeV protons)
noaa.note: Verified public URL. R-scale: M1=R1, M5=R2, X1=R3, X10=R4, X20=R5; C-class is R0.

xray.used: Live long-wave X-ray flux and GOES class (flare class derived from this flux)
xray.note: Verified public URL. Empty and timeout stay empty/timeout; nothing is interpolated. Not a NASA DONKI FLR record.

proton.note: Verified public URL. The demo SPE scenario is labeled separately and never overwritten as official.

donki.used: GST / CME / SEP / notifications catalog (FLR is not queried)
donki.note: Verified public URL. Timeout and empty window are labeled separately: timeout ≠ confirmed no events. Flare class comes from NOAA GOES X-ray.

osdr.used: Public astronaut health and life-science data portal
osdr.note: Verified public URL. Demo thresholds are not bound to a single OSDR study DOI.

ntrs.note: Verified public URL. Unverified report numbers or titles are not cited.

analysis.overallCritical: One or more physiology metrics are in the critical band. Take countermeasures and notify the ground.
analysis.overallCaution: Overall caution: some metrics are off the demo band, not immediately critical.
analysis.overallNormal: Overall normal. Mission fitness is acceptable.
analysis.hrCritical: Resting HR {value} exceeds the microgravity demo critical band (>100 bpm). May relate to fluid shift, autonomic imbalance, or dehydration.
analysis.hrCaution: Resting HR {value} is above the orbital demo ideal (50–90 bpm), not yet critical tachycardia.
analysis.hrNormal: Resting HR {value} is in the demo normal band.
analysis.hrvCritical: HRV {value}: severe autonomic suppression (<20 ms). May relate to sleep debt, overtraining, or load.
analysis.hrvCaution: HRV {value} is below ideal (≥25 ms); recovery is reduced.
analysis.spo2Critical: SpO₂ {value} is below the cabin demo critical band (<94%). Check ECLSS O₂/CO₂.
analysis.spo2Caution: SpO₂ {value} is slightly below demo ideal (≥96%).
analysis.vo2Off: VO₂ max {value}: aerobic reserve is low; microgravity can accelerate deconditioning.
analysis.vo2Ok: VO₂ max {value}: aerobic baseline is acceptable.
analysis.sleepOff: Average sleep {value} is under the 7-hour demo target and may affect cognition and HRV recovery.
analysis.sleepOk: Average sleep {value} meets the demo recovery target.
analysis.exOff: Exercise countermeasure {value} is off the ISS-informed demo prescription (~90–210 min).
analysis.exOk: Exercise countermeasure {value} matches the demo prescription band.

hrp.scienceKicker: Best Use of Science · Space Apps 2026 Taipei
hrp.scienceLead: Every SpaceMoni feature mapped to an HRP risk, NASA-STD-3001 section, and data source. Table text is English for judges; chrome around it is localized. Nothing here is a NASA product.
hrp.scienceFoot: LIVE = NOAA/GOES or DONKI at runtime. SOURCED-STATIC = cited publication or standard. SIMULATION = demo crew/world. ASSUMPTION = labeled demo formula, not a NASA equation. 250 mSv 30-day SPE bound is a historical PEL not restated in attached Vol 2 Rev F.
hrp.solCite: Sol length 24 h 39 m 35 s · NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 lighting rationale (~24 h 40 min Mars cycle)
hrp.eihsoCite: EIHSO-202 item 2 — Recommendations for semi-autonomous monitoring dashboard (HRP RAP June 2026).
hrp.crewActList: Shelter, hydrate, self-check, sleep, SANS, mood check-in, egress self-test
hrp.groundActList: EVA go, medevac, abort, pharmacy, habitat repress
hrp.queuedNote: Crew uplink (simulation): requesting delayed ground review.
hrp.auNote: Simulated AU from Earth: {au} (not JPL Horizons)
hrp.speQuietDetail: No DONKI SEP and GOES protons below NOAA S1.
hrp.artemisCite: Artemis I HERA GCR 0.96–1.24 mSv d⁻¹; HSU2 13.47 mGy (George et al., Nature 2024, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07927-7).
hrp.careerSim: Career total is a simulated accumulation, not a measured crew dose.
hrp.doseLine: GCR analog {gcr} mSv + SPE extra {spe} mSv = {total} mSv · {pctC}% of 600 mSv career (V2 6095 / Vol 1 §4.8) · {pctS}% of 250 mSv 30-day SPE bound (historical PEL)
hrp.baselineNote: Ship GCR baseline {n} mSv/d is a labeled simulation scaled by shielding.

shelter.move: Move crew to the highest-shielding volume
shelter.eva: Terminate EVA; no new EVA until S-scale declines
shelter.water: Use ECLSS water / gray-water mass as additional SPE shielding if procedure allows (HHP 2023)
shelter.cmo: CMO reviews prodromal symptoms; AURA is decision support, not a diagnosis
shelter.ground: Queue a delayed ground report (EIHSO-202); do not wait for sign-off to shelter

hrp.moodCite: BH-201 / Team-201 — indicators and thresholds for semi-autonomous BHP/team monitoring (HRP RAP June 2026). Scores are SIMULATION, not clinical psychometrics.
hrp.sansCite: SANS-101 / SANS-404; IRP-47065 §4.3.9. Amsler analog + logMAR. Not OCT.
hrp.osdrCite: OSD-569 CBC and OSD-575 metabolic panel / cytokines. Anonymized C001–C004. Timepoints L-92, L-44, L-3, R+1, R+45, R+82, R+194. Simulated crew overlay is an analog, not identity.
hrp.osdrZ: Sim analog {analog}: z={z} ({band}) vs that series’ L-3
hrp.sleepSolCite: Sol 24 h 39 m 35 s next to UTC/MTC analog. Sleep debt and PVT are SIMULATION (BH-201 / circadian rationale).
hrp.sleepDebt: Sleep debt {h} h · PVT analog {pvt} ms · circadian drift {drift} h vs 24.0 h
hrp.egressCite: [V2 7042] orthostatic countermeasures; SM-106 / SM-206 postural control after G-transition. Scores are SIMULATION stand-test analogs.
hrp.notDiagnosis: Not a diagnosis. AURA is decision support for the crew medical officer.
hrp.docInABox: Works offline (Doc-in-a-Box / Earth-independent medical capability, HHP 2023).
hrp.cmoHrDetail: Resting HR is off the personal/demo band. Recheck after rest and hydrate. Not a diagnosis.
hrp.cmoSpo2Detail: SpO₂ off band. Verify ECLSS ppO₂ (simulated cabin) and sensor contact. Not a diagnosis.
hrp.cmoSleepDetail: Sleep under 6 h. Protect the next sleep period (BH-201). Not a diagnosis.
hrp.cmoSpeDetail: S-scale {scale}. Crew-autonomous shelter; do not wait for ground (EIHSO-202). Career PEL {career}; 30-day SPE bound {spe30}. Not a diagnosis.
hrp.cmoSansDetail: Vision analog off nominal. Repeat Amsler/logMAR and log for CMO. Not OCT, not a diagnosis.
hrp.cmoBhpDetail: BH-201 indicators crossed a demo threshold. Offer a private check-in. Not a psychiatric diagnosis.
hrp.cmoEihsoDetail: One-way delay {sec} s. Prefer crew-autonomous actions; queue ground items.
hrp.baselineCite: Each metric vs that person’s own pre-mission baseline (z-score). Caution |z|≥1.5, off |z|≥2.5 — demo policy, not a NASA table.
hrp.delayMarsAu: Mars one-way {delay} from simulated AU (circular-orbit analog, not JPL Horizons)
hrp.delayUnknown: Unknown station — delay treated as 0 s
hrp.speDrill: Drill / SIMULATION — preview WATCH and SHELTER
hrp.egressReturnCite: [V2 7042] orthostatic countermeasures; SM-106 / SM-206. Harmony: return-to-Earth egress analog. Scores are SIMULATION.
hrp.cmoHrvDetail: Heart-rate variability is off the demo band. Rest, hydrate, and recheck. Cited [V2 7042]. Not a diagnosis.
